calibration_requirement: Current source-verified K/F screen and independent 16-task-per-cell validation pass the manifest-bound require_candidates/allow_fresh_ceiling design. No selecting or tuning on R outcomes.
eligibility: Require independent receipt/source/accounting replay to pass and no unresolved global source, information-access or accounting stop. Systemic validity failures do not become an inferential result.
missingness: Keep unknown scores missing; no imputation, retry or outcome-dependent replacement. The maximum-completion p-value equals the standard exact test when every pair is observed and never reduces the complete-case p-value.
power_limitation: The planned 80% target assumes complete observation and its stated alternative. No 80% power guarantee under arbitrary missingness.

power_plan.method: exact unconditional power of two-sided conditional McNemar test
power_plan.scope: independent task pairs; assumed discordance and effect, not empirical assurance

primary_contrast: Complete-episode binary success R minus K on every fixed selected task.
primary_decision: Two-sided exact paired test at alpha=1/20; reject only when the maximum p-value over every feasible completion of missing binary scores is <=1/20. Direction follows the sharp fixed-denominator effect bounds.
sample_rule: Equal tasks per validated cell; ceil(planned_pairs / number_of_cells) replicates per cell. Freeze the resulting exact N, seed, manifest and full generation bound before first confirmation dispatch.
scope: Future fixed-size confirmation only; existing control results and original engine reports remain unchanged.
secondary: Arm rates, family diagnostics and recorded resources are descriptive. Missingness bounds are not population confidence intervals.
standard_engine_report: Preserve its original confirmatory-p suppression when any score is missing; produce a separately labelled amendment report bound to this precommit.
stopping: Run the entire fixed allocation; no interim significance stopping or extension to obtain significance.
supersedes: Prior prospective precommit retained unchanged; same statistical method, new control-only six-action design after failed five-action validation. No v6 R outcomes exist.
